description: Fetch and inspect one package reference (pin an exact version for reproducibility), then return a redacted SAFE, REVIEW, or BLOCK report without running lifecycle scripts, package code, or writing package files outside temporary quarantine. Local references are confined to operator-approved roots.

deep.description: Reserved — guard already runs the full pipeline; passed through for parity with audit_lockfile_supply_chain.

githubDiff.description: Set false to skip the npm-vs-GitHub source diff (saves a tarball download).

githubMetadata.description: Set false to skip the GitHub provenance cross-check.

quarantineRoot.description: Optional staging root under an operator-approved filesystem root. Omit to use an internally selected OS temporary directory.

reference.description: Exact package reference, preferably npm:name@version. Local file:path or directory references must resolve under an operator-approved root.

sourceScan.description: Set false to stage and vulnerability-check without collecting source files.

vulnerabilityCheck.description: Set false to skip OSV vulnerability intelligence checks.

name: guard_agent_extension_install
title: Guard a package before installation
